title_en: DyPE: Dynamic Position Extrapolation for Ultra High Resolution Diffusion
title_zh: DyPE：用于超高分辨率扩散的动态位置外推

sentences.en: Diffusion Transformer models can generate images with remarkable fidelity and detail, yet training them at ultra-high resolutions remains extremely costly due to the self-attention mechanism's quadratic scaling with the number of image tokens.
sentences.zh: 扩散 Transformer 模型可以生成具有非凡保真度与细节的图像，然而由于自注意力机制随图像词元数量二次扩展，在超高分辨率下训练它们仍然极其昂贵。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce Dynamic Position Extrapolation (DyPE), a novel, training-free method that enables pre-trained diffusion transformers to synthesize images at resolutions far beyond their training data, with no additional sampling cost.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入动态位置外推（DyPE），一种新颖的免训练方法，它使预训练扩散 Transformer 能够在远超其训练数据的分辨率下合成图像，且无额外采样成本。

sentences.en: DyPE takes advantage of the spectral progression inherent to the diffusion process, where low-frequency structures converge early, while high-frequencies take more steps to resolve.
sentences.zh: DyPE 利用扩散过程固有的频谱进展，其中低频结构早收敛，而高频需要更多步骤解析。

sentences.en: Specifically, DyPE dynamically adjusts the model's positional encoding at each diffusion step, matching their frequency spectrum with the current stage of the generative process.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，DyPE 在每个扩散步骤动态调整模型的位置编码，使其频率谱与生成过程的当前阶段匹配。

sentences.en: This approach allows us to generate images at resolutions that exceed the training resolution dramatically, e.g., 16 million pixels using FLUX.
sentences.zh: 这种方法使我们能够生成大幅超过训练分辨率的高分辨率图像，例如使用 FLUX 生成 1600 万像素图像。

sentences.en: On multiple benchmarks, DyPE consistently improves performance and achieves state-of-the-art fidelity in ultra-high-resolution image generation, with gains becoming even more pronounced at higher resolutions.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准上，DyPE 一致改善性能，并在超高分辨率图像生成中实现最先进的保真度，在更高分辨率下增益更加明显。

title_en: Dywave: Event-Aligned Dynamic Tokenization for Heterogeneous IoT Sensing Signals
title_zh: Dywave：异质物联网感知信号的事件对齐动态词元化

sentences.en: Internet of Things (IoT) systems continuously collect heterogeneous sensing signals from ubiquitous sensors to support intelligent applications such as human activity analysis, emotion monitoring, and environmental perception.
sentences.zh: 物联网（IoT）系统从无处不在的传感器持续收集异构传感信号，以支持人类活动分析、情绪监控与环境感知等智能应用。

sentences.en: These signals are inherently non-stationary and multi-scale, posing unique challenges for standard tokenization techniques.
sentences.zh: 这些信号固有地非平稳且多尺度，对标准词元化技术提出独特挑战。

sentences.en: This paper proposes Dywave, a dynamic tokenization framework for IoT sensing signals that constructs compact input representations aligned with intrinsic temporal structures and underlying physical events.
sentences.zh: 本文提出 Dywave，一个用于 IoT 传感信号的动态词元化框架，它构造与内在时间结构和底层物理事件对齐的紧凑输入表示。

sentences.en: Dywave leverages wavelet-based hierarchical decomposition, identifies meaningful temporal boundaries corresponding to underlying semantic events, and adaptively compresses redundant intervals while preserving temporal coherence.
sentences.zh: Dywave 利用基于小波的层级分解，识别与底层语义事件对应的有意义时间边界，并在保持时间连贯性的同时自适应压缩冗余区间。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations on five real-world IoT sensing datasets across activity recognition, stress assessment, and nearby object detection demonstrate that Dywave outperforms state-of-the-art methods by up to 12% in accuracy, while improving computational efficiency by reducing input token lengths by up to 75\% across mainstream sequence models.
sentences.zh: 在活动识别、压力评估与邻近对象检测五个真实世界 IoT 传感数据集上的大量评估表明，Dywave 在准确率上超越最先进方法至多 12%，同时通过跨主流序列模型将输入词元长度减少至多 75[B]% 来提升计算效率。

sentences.en: Moreover, Dywave exhibits improved robustness to domain shifts and varying sequence lengths.
sentences.zh: 此外，Dywave 展现出对域偏移与变化序列长度的改善稳健性。

title_en: D²Evo: Dual Difficulty-Aware Self-Evolution for Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: D²Evo：通过双重难度感知自进化实现数据高效强化学习

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated potential for enhancing reasoning in large language models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 强化学习（RL）已展现出增强大语言模型（LLM）推理的潜力。

sentences.en: However, effective RL training, which requires medium-difficulty training samples, faces two fundamental challenges: Effective Data Scarcity and Dynamic Difficulty Shifts, where medium-difficulty samples are scarce and become trivial as models improve.
sentences.zh: 然而，有效的 RL 训练需要中等难度训练样本，面临两个根本挑战：有效数据稀缺与动态难度偏移，其中中等难度样本稀缺，并随模型改进而变得平凡。

sentences.en: Existing methods mitigate this scarcity to some extent by generating training samples.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通过生成训练样本在一定程度上缓解这种稀缺性。

sentences.en: However, these approaches suffer from anchor-free generation, ignoring co-evolution, and difficulty mismatch.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些方法遭受无锚生成、忽视共同演化与难度不匹配之苦。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose D²Evo, a Dual Difficulty-aware self-Evolution RL framework.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出 D$^2$Evo，一个双重难度感知的自我演化 RL 框架。

sentences.en: In each iteration, our method mines medium-difficulty anchors based on the current Solver's capability, trains the Questioner to generate diverse questions at appropriate difficulty levels, and jointly optimizes both components to enable progressive reasoning gains.
sentences.zh: 在每次迭代中，我们的方法基于当前求解器的能力挖掘中等难度锚点，训练提问者生成合适难度水平的多样问题，并联合优化两个组件以实现渐进推理增益。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that D²Evo outperforms existing methods on mathematical reasoning benchmarks with fewer than 2K real mathematical samples, and exhibits strong generalization on general reasoning benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，D$^2$Evo 在少于 2K 个真实数学样本的数学推理基准上超越现有方法，并在通用推理基准上展现出强泛化。

title_en: E-mem: Multi-Agent Based Episodic Context Reconstruction for LLM Agent Memory
title_zh: E-mem：面向大语言模型智能体记忆的多智能体情景上下文重建

sentences.en: The evolution of Large Language Model (LLM) agents towards System~2 reasoning, characterized by deliberative, high-precision problem-solving, necessitates maintaining rigorous logical integrity over extended horizons.
sentences.zh: LLM 智能体向系统 2 推理（以深思熟虑、高精度问题求解为特征）的演化，需要长时间维持严格的逻辑完整性。

sentences.en: However, prevalent memory preprocessing paradigms incur destructive de-contextualization.
sentences.zh: 然而，普遍的记忆预处理范式招致破坏性的去上下文化。

sentences.en: By compressing fluid sequential dependencies into pre-defined structures (e.g., embeddings or graphs), these methods sever the narrative integrity essential for deep reasoning.
sentences.zh: 通过将流动的顺序依赖压缩进预定义结构（例如嵌入或图），这些方法切断了深度推理所需的叙事完整性。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose E-mem, a framework shifting from Memory Preprocessing to Episodic Context Reconstruction inspired by biological engrams.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出 E-mem，一个受生物记忆痕（engram）启发、从记忆预处理转向情景上下文重建的框架。

sentences.en: E-mem employs a heterogeneous hierarchical architecture where multiple assistant agents maintain uncompressed memory contexts, while a central master agent orchestrates global planning.
sentences.zh: E-mem 采用异构层级架构，其中多个辅助智能体维护未压缩的记忆上下文，而一个中央主智能体编排全局规划。

sentences.en: Unlike passive retrieval, our mechanism empowers assistants to locally reason within activated segments, extracting context-aware evidence before aggregation.
sentences.zh: 与被动检索不同，我们的机制使辅助智能体能够在激活的片段内进行局部推理，在聚合之前提取上下文感知的证据。

sentences.en: Evaluations on the LoCoMo benchmark demonstrate that E-mem achieves over 54\% F1—surpassing the state-of-the-art GAM by 7.75\%—while reducing token cost by over 70\%.
sentences.zh: 在 LoCoMo 基准上的评估表明，E-mem 实现超过 54\% 的 F1 ——超越最先进的 GAM 7.75\%——同时将词元成本降低超过 70\%。

sentences.en: Our work is available on \url{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/E-mem-F6C3/}.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/E-mem-F6C3/ 获取。

title_en: E-VAds: An E-commerce Short Videos Understanding Benchmark for MLLMs
title_zh: E-VAds：多模态大语言模型的电子商务短视频理解基准

sentences.en: E-commerce short videos represent a high-revenue segment of the online video industry characterized by a goal-driven format and dense multi-modal signals.
sentences.zh: 电商短视频是在线视频行业中高收入板块，以目标驱动形式与密集多模态信号为特征。

sentences.en: Current models often struggle with these videos because existing benchmarks focus primarily on general-purpose tasks and neglect the reasoning of commercial intent.
sentences.zh: 当前模型常常难以理解这些视频，因为现有基准主要聚焦于通用任务，忽视商业意图的推理。

sentences.en: In this work, we first propose a **multi-modal information density assessment framework** to quantify the complexity of this domain.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们首先提出一个**多模态信息密度评估框架**，以量化该领域的复杂度。

sentences.en: Our evaluation reveals that e-commerce content exhibits substantially higher density across visual, audio, and textual modalities compared to mainstream datasets, establishing a more challenging frontier for video understanding.
sentences.zh: 我们的评估揭示，与主流数据集相比，电商内容在视觉、音频与文本模态上展现出显著更高的密度，为视频理解确立更具挑战性的前沿。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce **E-commerce Video Ads Benchmark**, which is the first benchmark specifically designed for e-commerce short video understanding.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一差距，我们引入**电商视频广告基准**，这是首个专门为电商短视频理解设计的基准。

sentences.en: We curated 3,961 high-quality videos from Taobao covering a wide range of product categories and used a multi-agent system to generate 19,785 open-ended Q\&A pairs.
sentences.zh: 我们从淘宝策展了覆盖广泛产品类别的 3,961 个高质量视频，并使用多智能体系统生成 19,785 个开放式问答对。

sentences.en: These questions are organized into Perception and Cognition and Reasoning, which consist of five distinct tasks.
sentences.zh: 这些问题被组织为感知与认知与推理两类，由五个不同任务组成。

sentences.en: Finally, we develop **E-VAds-R1**, an RL-based reasoning model featuring a multi-grained reward design called **MG-GRPO**.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们开发 **E-VAds-R1**，一个配备称为 **MG-GRPO** 的多粒度奖励设计的基于 RL 的推理模型。

sentences.en: This strategy provides smooth guidance for early exploration while creating a non-linear incentive for expert-level precision.
sentences.zh: 这种策略为早期探索提供平滑引导，同时为专家级精度创造非线性激励。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that E-VAds-R1 achieves a 109.2\% performance gain in commercial intent reasoning with only a few hundred training samples.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，E-VAds-R1 仅用几百个训练样本就在商业意图推理中实现 109.2\% 的性能增益。

sentences.en: Data is available at https://github.com/TaobaoTmall-AlgorithmProducts/E-VAds_Benchmark.
sentences.zh: 数据可在 https://github.com/TaobaoTmall-AlgorithmProducts/E-VAds_Benchmark 获取。

title_en: E2Former-V2: On-the-Fly Equivariant Attention  with Linear Activation Memory
title_zh: E2Former-V2：具有线性激活内存开销的即时等变注意力

sentences.en: Equivariant Graph Neural Networks (EGNNs) have become a widely used approach for modeling 3D atomistic systems.
sentences.zh: 等变图神经网络（EGNN）已成为建模 3D 原子系统的广泛使用的方法。

sentences.en: However, mainstream architectures face critical efficiency bottlenecks due to the explicit construction of geometric features or dense tensor products on \textit{every} edge.
sentences.zh: 然而，主流架构由于在*每条*边上的显式几何特征构造或密集张量乘积而面临关键效率瓶颈。

sentences.en: To overcome this, we introduce \textbf{E2Former-V2}, an efficient architecture that integrates algebraic sparsity with hardware-aware execution.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一点，我们引入 \textbf{E2Former-V2}，一个将代数稀疏性与硬件感知执行相结合的高效架构。

sentences.en: We introduce \textbf{Equivariant Axis-Aligned Sparsification (EAAS)}, which leverages an $\mathrm{SO}(3)\!\rightarrow\!\mathrm{SO}(2)$ change of basis to convert dense Wigner-$6j$ tensor contractions into sparse, parity-based re-indexing operations.
sentences.zh: 我们引入$\textbf{Equivariant Axis-Aligned Sparsification (EAAS)}$，它利用 $\mathrm{SO}(3)\rightarrow\mathrm{SO}(2)$ 基变更将稠密 Wigner-6j 张量收缩转换为稀疏的、基于奇偶校验的重索引操作。

sentences.en: Building on this representation, we propose \textbf{On-the-Fly Equivariant Attention}, a fully node-centric mechanism implemented via a fused Triton kernel.
sentences.zh: 在此表示的基础上，我们提出$\textbf{On-the-Fly Equivariant Attention}$，一种通过融合 Triton 内核实现的完全以节点为中心的机制。

sentences.en: By eliminating materialized edge tensors and maximizing SRAM utilization, our kernel achieves up to \textbf{20$\times$ higher TFLOPS} than standard implementations.
sentences.zh: 通过消除实体化边张量并最大化 SRAM 利用率，我们的内核实现至多 **20$\times$ 更高的 TFLOPS**，相较标准实现。

sentences.en: Experiments on SPICE and OMol25 show that E2Former-V2 preserves predictive accuracy while substantially accelerating inference, demonstrating the practical feasibility of large equivariant transformers on commodity GPUs.
sentences.zh: 在 SPICE 与 OMol25 上的实验表明，E2Former-V2 在显著加速推断的同时保持预测准确率，展示了大型等变 Transformer 在商用 GPU 上的实际可行性。

sentences.en: Our released code can be found at \url{https://github.com/IQuestLab/UBio-MolFM/tree/main}
sentences.zh: 我们发布的代码可在 https://github.com/IQuestLab/UBio-MolFM/tree/main 获取。

title_en: EAGer: Entropy-Aware GEneRation for Adaptive Inference-Time Scaling
title_zh: EAGer：通过熵感知生成实现自适应推理时扩展

sentences.en: With the rise of reasoning language models and test-time scaling methods as a paradigm for improving model performance, substantial computation is often required to generate multiple candidate sequences from the same prompt.
sentences.zh: 随着推理语言模型与测试时扩展方法作为改善模型性能范式的兴起，从相同提示生成多个候选序列常常需要大量计算。

sentences.en: This enables exploration of different reasoning paths toward the correct solution, however, allocates the same compute budget for each prompt.
sentences.zh: 这支持探索通向正确解的不同推理路径，然而为每个提示分配相同的计算预算。

sentences.en: Grounded on the assumption that different prompts carry different degrees of complexity, and thus different computation needs, we propose EAGer, a training-free generation method that leverages model uncertainty through token-wise entropy distribution to reduce redundant computation and concurrently improve overall performance.
sentences.zh: 基于不同提示具有不同复杂度、因此具有不同计算需求的假设，我们提出 EAGer，一种免训练生成方法，它通过词元级熵分布利用模型不确定性来减少冗余计算，并同时改善整体性能。

sentences.en: EAGer allows branching to multiple reasoning paths only in the presence of high-entropy tokens, and reallocates the saved compute budget to instances where exploration of alternative paths is most needed.
sentences.zh: EAGer 仅在高熵词元存在时才允许分支到多个推理路径，并将节省的计算预算重新分配到最需要探索替代路径的实例。

sentences.en: We validate EAGer across multiple open-source models on complex reasoning benchmarks, with gains specifically demonstrated on AIME 2025.
sentences.zh: 我们在复杂推理基准上跨多个开源模型验证 EAGer，增益在 AIME 2025 上尤其明显。

sentences.en: When target labels are accessible -- as in RLVR training pipelines -- EAGer achieves up to +37% in Pass@k and 59% fewer tokens; in test-time settings it still yields +12% in Pass@k and 64% fewer tokens compared to Full Parallel Sampling.
sentences.zh: 当目标标签可访问时（如同 RLVR 训练流水线中），EAGer 实现 Pass@k 至多 +37%，词元减少 59%；在测试时情境中，相较完全并行采样仍实现 Pass@k +12%，词元减少 64%。

title_en: EAKV: An Entropy-Driven Adaptive KV Compression Framework for Long Video Understanding
title_zh: EAKV：用于长视频理解的熵驱动自适应 KV 压缩框架

sentences.en: Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made remarkable progress, they still struggle with long-video understanding due to the massive memory footprint of KV Caches.
sentences.zh: 虽然多模态大语言模型（MLLM）已取得显著进展，但它们仍因 KV 缓存的巨大内存占用而在长视频理解上表现挣扎。

sentences.en: Existing methods often resort to disjoint retrieval or attention-based reduction with a uniform layer-wise budget to achieve compression.
sentences.zh: 现有方法常常诉诸不相交的检索或带均匀逐层预算的基于注意力的归约来实现压缩。

sentences.en: However, these methods disrupt temporal continuity and ignore the varying information density across network layers.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些方法破坏时间连续性，并忽视跨网络层变化的信息密度。

sentences.en: In this work, we reveal that memory allocation should mirror layer-wise semantic density, rather than adhering to a uniform budget.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们揭示内存分配应反映逐层语义密度，而非遵循均匀预算。

sentences.en: To this end, we introduce EAKV, a training-free entropy-driven adaptive KV compression framework that leverages attention entropy to adaptively allocate compression budgets, selectively preserving critical tokens while distilling redundant contexts into compact contextual anchors, thereby achieving granular memory allocation proportional to semantic density.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们引入 EAKV，一个免训练的熵驱动自适应 KV 压缩框架，它利用注意力熵自适应地分配压缩预算，选择性地保留关键词元，同时将冗余上下文蒸馏为紧凑的上下文锚点，从而实现与语义密度成比例的粒度内存分配。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate that EAKV surpasses existing methods across diverse model architectures and varying parameter scales, yielding improvements ranging from 0.6% to 6.5%.
sentences.zh: 在各种基准上的大量实验表明，EAKV 在多样模型架构与不同参数规模上超越现有方法，改进幅度从 0.6% 到 6.5%。

title_en: EAPO: Enhancing Policy Optimization with On-Demand Expert Assistance
title_zh: EAPO：通过按需专家协助增强策略优化

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) have recently advanced in reasoning when optimized with reinforcement learning (RL) under verifiable rewards.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）近来在可验证奖励下用强化学习（RL）优化时在推理方面取得进展。

sentences.en: Existing methods primarily rely on outcome-based supervision to strengthen internal LLM reasoning, often leading to inefficient exploration and sparse rewards.
sentences.zh: 现有方法主要依赖基于结果的监督来强化内部 LLM 推理，常常导致低效探索与稀疏奖励。

sentences.en: To mitigate this issue, we propose Expert-Assisted Policy Optimization (EAPO), a novel RL framework that enhances exploration by incorporating multi-turn interactions with external experts during training.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一问题，我们提出专家辅助策略优化（EAPO），一个通过在训练期间纳入与外部专家的多轮交互来增强探索的新颖 RL 框架。

sentences.en: Unlike prior methods, where policies reason in isolation, EAPO incentivizes the policy to adaptively determine when and how to consult experts, yielding richer reward signals and more reliable reasoning trajectories.
sentences.zh: 与策略孤立推理的先前方法不同，EAPO 激励策略自适应地决定何时以及如何咨询专家，产生更丰富的奖励信号与更可靠的推理轨迹。

sentences.en: External assistance ultimately internalizes expert knowledge into the policy model, amplifying the model’s inherent reasoning capabilities.
sentences.zh: 外部协助最终将专家知识内化为策略模型，放大模型固有的推理能力。

sentences.en: During evaluation, the policy model has been well-optimized to solve questions independently, producing improved reasoning paths and more accurate solutions.
sentences.zh: 在评估时，策略模型已被充分优化以独立解决问题，产生改进的推理路径与更准确的解。

sentences.en: On AIME 2024/2025 and AIMO 2025, EAPO consistently outperforms expert-assisted, expert-distilled, and RL baselines, averaging a 5-point gain over self-exploration RL, and also generalizes to non-math benchmarks, including HumanEval, HLE, GPQA, MMLU, EvalPlus, HotpotQA, and SimpleQA.
sentences.zh: 在 AIME 2024/2025 与 AIMO 2025 上，EAPO 一致超越专家辅助、专家蒸馏与 RL 基线，平均比自我探索 RL 高出 5 分，并泛化到非数学基准，包括 HumanEval、HLE、GPQA、MMLU、EvalPlus、HotpotQA 与 SimpleQA。

authors.name: Siyao Song
authors.institution: Institute of automation, Chinese academy of science, Chinese Academy of Sciences

title_en: EARL: Towards a Unified Analysis-Guided Reinforcement Learning Framework for Egocentric Interaction Reasoning and Pixel Grounding
title_zh: EARL：迈向第一视角交互推理与像素定位的统一分析引导强化学习框架

sentences.en: A precise and comprehensive understanding of human-environment interactions in egocentric vision is essential for next-generation intelligent agents, such as assistive robotics.
sentences.zh: 对自我中心视觉中人与环境交互的精确且全面理解，对诸如辅助机器人技术的下一代智能智能体至关重要。

sentences.en: While existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) support unified reasoning from scene-level analysis to instance-specific grounding, their accuracy and generalization remain limited.
sentences.zh: 虽然现有的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）支持从场景级分析到实例特定立足的统一推理，但它们的准确率与泛化仍然有限。

sentences.en: To this end, this paper introduces a novel Egocentric Analysis-guided RL-based method (EARL) that employs Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to enhance the interaction understanding of MLLMs in first-person vision.
sentences.zh: 为此，本文引入一种新颖的自我中心分析引导的基于 RL 方法（EARL），它采用组相对策略优化（GRPO）增强第一人称视觉中 MLLM 的交互理解。

sentences.en: Specifically, EARL adopts a two-stage parsing framework including coarse-grained interpretation and fine-grained response.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，EARL 采用一个两阶段解析框架，包括粗粒度解释与细粒度响应。

sentences.en: The first stage holistically interprets egocentric interactions and generates a structured textual description.
sentences.zh: 第一阶段整体解释自我中心交互，并生成结构化的文本描述。

sentences.en: The second stage produces the language answer and corresponding pixel-level grounding mask in response to the user query.
sentences.zh: 第二阶段响应用户查询产生语言答案与相应的像素级立足掩码。

sentences.en: To bridge the two stages, we extract a global interaction descriptor from the first stage and treat it as a semantic prior, which is then integrated via a novel Analysis-guided Feature Synthesizer (AFS) to support query-oriented reasoning.
sentences.zh: 为桥接两个阶段，我们从第一阶段提取一个全局交互描述符，将其视为语义先验，随后通过一个新颖的分析引导特征综合器（AFS）整合，以支持查询导向的推理。

sentences.en: Furthermore, to effectively guide policy optimization, we design a sophisticated, multi-faceted reward mechanism that incorporates format correctness, answer relevance, and grounding accuracy.
sentences.zh: 此外，为有效引导策略优化，我们设计一个精妙的、多面的奖励机制，纳入格式正确性、答案相关性与立足准确率。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that EARL achieves an impressive 65.48% cIoU on the Ego-IRGBench benchmark for pixel grounding, surpassing previous state-of-the-art RL-based methods by 8.37%.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，EARL 在 Ego-IRGBench 基准上实现令人印象深刻的 65.48% cIoU 像素立足，超越先前最先进的基于 RL 方法 8.37%。

sentences.en: Superior performance in out-of-distribution evaluations further validates EARL's generalization capability.
sentences.zh: 分布外评估中的卓越性能进一步验证了 EARL 的泛化能力。

authors.name: Zhen Ye
authors.institution: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

title_en: Early Decisions Matter: Proximity Bias and Initial Trajectory Shaping in Non-Autoregressive Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: 早期决策至关重要：非自回归扩散语言模型中的邻近偏差与初始轨迹塑形

sentences.en: Diffusion-based language models(dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models, offering the potential for parallel token generation and bidirectional context modeling.
sentences.zh: 基于扩散的语言模型（dLLM）已成为自回归语言模型的有前景替代方案，提供并行词元生成与双向上下文建模的潜力。

sentences.en: However, harnessing this flexibility for fully non-autoregressive decoding remains an open question, particularly for reasoning and planning tasks.
sentences.zh: 然而，利用这种灵活性实现完全非自回归解码仍是一个开放问题，尤其是在推理与规划任务中。

sentences.en: In this work, we investigate non-autoregressive decoding in dLLMs by systematically analyzing its inference dynamics along the temporal axis.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们通过沿时间轴系统分析其推断动态，研究 dLLM 中的非自回归解码。

sentences.en: Specifically, we uncover an inherent failure modes in confidence-based non-autoregressive generation stem from a strong proximity bias—the denoising order tends to concentrate on spatially adjacent tokens.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们揭示基于置信度的非自回归生成中固有的失败模式源于强烈的邻近偏差——去噪顺序倾向于集中在空间相邻词元上。

sentences.en: This local dependency leads to spatial error propagation, rendering the entire trajectory critically contingent on the initial unmasking position.
sentences.zh: 这种局部依赖导致空间误差传播，使整个轨迹严格依赖于初始去掩码位置。

sentences.en: Leveraging this insight, we present a minimal-intervention approach that guides early token selection, employing a lightweight planner and end-of-sequence temperature annealing.
sentences.zh: 利用这一洞见，我们提出一种最小干预方法，它采用轻量级规划器与序列结束温度退火来引导早期词元选择。

sentences.en: We thoroughly evaluate our method on various reasoning and planning tasks and observe substantial overall improvement over existing heuristic baselines without significant computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 我们在各种推理与规划任务上彻底评估我们的方法，并观察到相对现有启发式基线在无显著计算开销情况下的持续整体改进。

title_en: Early Directional Convergence in Deep Homogeneous Neural Networks for Small Initializations
title_zh: 小初始化条件下深度齐次神经网络的早期方向收敛

sentences.en: This paper studies the gradient flow dynamics that arise when training deep homogeneous neural networks assumed to have locally Lipschitz gradients and an order of homogeneity strictly greater than two.
sentences.zh: 本文研究训练被假设具有局部 Lipschitz 梯度且齐次阶严格大于 2 的深层齐次神经网络时产生的梯度流动态。

sentences.en: It is shown here that for sufficiently small initializations, during the early stages of training, the weights of the neural network remain small in (Euclidean) norm and approximately converge in direction to the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) points of the recently introduced neural correlation function.
sentences.zh: 这里表明，对于足够小的初始化，在训练的早期阶段，神经网络的权重保持小的（欧几里得）范数，并在方向上近似收敛到近期引入的神经相关函数的 Karush-Kuhn-Tucker（KKT）点。

sentences.en: Additionally, this paper also studies the KKT points of the neural correlation function for feed-forward networks with (Leaky) ReLU and polynomial (Leaky) ReLU activations, deriving necessary and sufficient conditions for rank-one KKT points.
sentences.zh: 此外，本文还研究具有（Leaky）ReLU 与多项式（Leaky）ReLU 激活的前馈网络的神经相关函数 KKT 点，推导秩 1 KKT 点的充分必要条件。

title_en: Easier to Judge than to Find: Predicting In-Context Learning Success for Demonstration Selection
title_zh: 判断比寻找容易：预测上下文学习成功率以选择示例

sentences.en: In-context learning (ICL) is highly sensitive to which demonstrations appear in the prompt, but selecting them is expensive because candidate contexts must be validated with repeated LLM calls.
sentences.zh: 上下文学习（ICL）对提示中出现哪些演示高度敏感，但选择它们代价高昂，因为候选上下文必须通过重复的 LLM 调用验证。

sentences.en: We argue that demonstration selection is \emph{easier to judge than to find}: predicting whether a specific query--context pair $(q,D)$ will succeed is cheaper and more general than searching for an optimal $D^\star$.
sentences.zh: 我们认为演示选择*判断比发现更容易*：预测特定查询-上下文对 (q,D) 是否会成功，比搜索最优 D* 更便宜且更通用。

sentences.en: Based on this insight, we propose DiSP, a sample-and-judge framework that stratifies queries by difficulty.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出 DiSP，一个按难度对查询分层的样本与判断框架。

sentences.en: DiSP runs random demonstration trials to estimate each training query's success rate, trains a lightweight router to predict difficulty from the query, and trains level-specific judges to score sampled contexts.
sentences.zh: DiSP 运行随机演示试验以估计每个训练查询的成功率，训练一个轻量级路由器从查询预测难度，并训练级别特定的判断器对采样上下文评分。

sentences.en: At inference, DiSP performs stop-on-acceptance judging under an explicit budget and typically makes a single LLM call, emitting diagnostic risk tags when no suitable context is found.
sentences.zh: 在推断时，DiSP 在显式预算下执行接受即停止判断，通常仅发起一次 LLM 调用，在未找到合适上下文时发出诊断风险标签。

sentences.en: Across five classification datasets with Llama 3–8B and Qwen 2.5–7B, DiSP achieves the best average accuracy, improving over strong learned selection baselines by up to 3.4%, while achieving up to 23× end-to-end wall-clock speedup.
sentences.zh: 在五个带 Llama 3-8B 与 Qwen 2.5-7B 的分类数据集上，DiSP 取得最佳平均准确率，超越强学习选择基线至多 3.4%，同时实现至多 23\times 的端到端墙钟加速。

title_en: EasyBalance: Cross-Layer Load Balancing in Distributed MoE Inference
title_zh: EasyBalance：分布式 MoE 推理的跨层负载均衡

sentences.en: Load Balancing has emerged as a critical problem in expert-parallel distributed inference of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models.
sentences.zh: 负载均衡已成为专家并行分布式混合专家（MoE）模型推断中的关键问题。

sentences.en: As routing distributions are typically skewed across experts, devices hosting lighter-loaded experts must idle to wait for the heaviest during expert computing, leading to inefficiency.
sentences.zh: 由于路由分布通常跨专家偏斜，托管负载较轻专家的设备必须空闲等待最重的专家完成专家计算，导致低效。

sentences.en: Existing load-balancing approaches primarily rely on expert replication or migration within each layer, which introduce additional overhead and limit their flexibility and scalability.
sentences.zh: 现有的负载均衡方法主要依赖每层内的专家复制或迁移，这引入额外开销并限制其灵活性与可扩展性。

sentences.en: To address this problem, we propose EasyBalance, a \textbf{cross-layer} load balancing strategy that requires no modifications to the expert-device mapping, enabling instant adaptability and incurring essentially no additional overhead.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出 EasyBalance，一种要求不修改专家-设备映射的**跨层**负载均衡策略，支持即时适配性并基本不引入额外开销。

sentences.en: Our key insights are that (1) experts from other layers can be viewed as naturally redundant, and (2) expert workloads of multiple layers can be jointly executed.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键洞见是：（1）来自其他层的专家可以被视为天然冗余的，并且（2）多个层的专家工作负载可以被联合执行。

sentences.en: Based on these observations, EasyBalance greedily schedules a subset of cross-layer workloads at each MoE-computation stage to run, while deferring the remaining workloads for future balancing opportunities.
sentences.zh: 基于这些观察，EasyBalance 在每个 MoE 计算阶段贪心调度跨层工作负载的一个子集运行，同时将剩余工作负载推迟到未来的均衡机会。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across different models, tasks, and parallelism configurations demonstrate that EasyBalance consistently accelerates distributed MoE inference, reducing GPU idling by mostly over 40\%.
sentences.zh: 跨不同模型、任务与并行配置的大量实验表明，EasyBalance 一致加速分布式 MoE 推断，将 GPU 空闲大多减少超过 40%。

title_en: Eating for a Sustainable Planet: Personalized Sustainable Diet Recommendation via Constraint-Aware Decision-Making Modeling
title_zh: 为可持续地球而饮食：通过约束感知决策建模推荐个性化可持续饮食

sentences.en: A sustainable diet represents a multi-dimensional synergy among four essential pillars: nutrition adequacy, economic affordability, cultural acceptability, and environmental respect.
sentences.zh: 可持续饮食代表四个基本支柱之间的多维协同：营养充分性、经济可负担性、文化可接受性与环境尊重。

sentences.en: Despite the prevalence of population-level sustainability modeling, practical implementation relies on effective individual-level adoption.
sentences.zh: 尽管人群级可持续性建模盛行，但实际实施依赖于有效的个体级采纳。

sentences.en: This transition is often hindered by inter-individual heterogeneity, posing a formidable challenge in aligning sustainable diet requirements with individual preferences.
sentences.zh: 这种转变常常受到个体间异质性的阻碍，构成将可持续饮食要求与个体偏好对齐的艰巨挑战。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose a personalized sustainable diet recommendation model based on a constraint-aware decision-making mechanism, where sustainability is incorporated through learnable constraints rather than modeled as user preferences.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出一个基于约束感知决策机制的个性化可持续饮食推荐模型，其中可持续性通过可学习约束纳入，而非建模为用户偏好。

sentences.en: To systematically evaluate the proposed approach, we construct a sustainable diet dataset named SusDiet with about 150k recipes, characterized by broad coverage of sustainability indicators across four dimensions.
sentences.zh: 为系统评估所提出的方法，我们构建一个名为 SusDiet 的可持续饮食数据集，包含约 15 万条食谱，其特征在于四个维度的可持续性指标广泛覆盖。

sentences.en: Experimental results on this dataset show that our method promotes more sustainable choices without compromising individual preference.
sentences.zh: 在此数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在不损害个体偏好的情况下促进更可持续的选择。

sentences.en: This work establishes a framework for aligning individual dietary choices with planetary health, offering quantitative evidence to guide future sustainable diet interventions and policy-making for sustainable development.
sentences.zh: 这项工作为将个体饮食选择与地球健康对齐建立了框架，为引导未来的可持续饮食干预与可持续发展政策制定提供定量证据。

title_en: ECA: Efficient Continual Alignment for Open-Ended Image-to-Text Generation
title_zh: ECA：开放式图像到文本生成的高效持续对齐

sentences.en: Incremental Learning (IL) for Open-ended Image-to-Text Generation (OpenITG) enables models to continuously generate accurate, contextually relevant text for new images while preserving previously acquired knowledge.
sentences.zh: 开放式文生图（OpenITG）的增量学习（IL）使模型能够在保留先前获得知识的同时，为新图像持续生成准确、上下文相关的文本。

sentences.en: Unlike prior studies, this paper addresses a more practical scenario in which the predominant category of visual data shifts over time as environments evolve.
sentences.zh: 与先前研究不同，本文应对一个更实际的情境，其中视觉数据的主要类别随环境演化而随时间变化。

sentences.en: In this context, we introduce a new notion of continual alignment, which incrementally adapts the alignment module within pre-trained VLMs to preserve high-quality cross-modal representations.
sentences.zh: 在此语境中，我们引入持续对齐的新概念，它增量适配预训练 VLM 内的对齐模块，以保持高质量的跨模态表示。

sentences.en: Based on this idea, we propose **E**fficient **C**ontinual **A**lignment (ECA), a novel exemplar-free IL approach for OpenITG.
sentences.zh: 基于这一思想，我们提出**高效持续对齐**（ECA），一种用于 OpenITG 的新颖免样本 IL 方法。

sentences.en: The key challenge is enabling the model to acquire new, task-specific features while minimizing interference with the established alignment without accessing raw data from previous tasks.
sentences.zh: 关键挑战是使模型在无法访问先前任务原始数据的情况下，获取新的任务特定特征，同时最小化对既定对齐的干扰。

sentences.en: To address this, ECA employs three core mechanisms: a **M**ixture **o**f **Q**uery (MoQ) module that adapts task-specific query tokens, a **F**ish**e**r **D**ynamic **Ex**pansion (FeDEx) that dynamically expands model structure based on a Fisher Information Matrix (FIM)-based metric, and an embedding dictionary with **D**ictionary **R**eplay (DR) to retain past knowledge.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，ECA 采用三种核心机制：一个适配任务特定查询词元的**查询混合**（MoQ）模块，一个基于 Fisher 信息矩阵（FIM）度量动态扩展模型结构的**Fisher 动态扩展**（FeDEx），以及一个通过**字典重放**（DR）保留过往知识的嵌入字典。

sentences.en: To evaluate ECA's performance, we construct four new IL OpenITG benchmarks that better reflect real-world scenarios.
sentences.zh: 为评估 ECA 的性能，我们构建四个能更好反映现实场景的新 IL OpenITG 基准。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that ECA significantly mitigates catastrophic forgetting and improves IL performance compared to baseline methods.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，相较基线方法，ECA 显著缓解灾难性遗忘并改善 IL 性能。

sentences.en: Code and benchmarks are available at https://github.com/Snowball0823/ECA.
sentences.zh: 代码与基准可在 https://github.com/Snowball0823/ECA 获取。

title_en: ECCO: Evidence-Driven Causal Reasoning for Compiler Optimization
title_zh: ECCO：用于编译器优化的证据驱动因果推理

sentences.en: Compiler auto-tuning faces a dichotomy between traditional black-box search methods, which lack semantic guidance, and recent Large Language Model (LLM) approaches, which often suffer from superficial pattern matching and causal opacity.
sentences.zh: 编译器自动调优面临传统黑盒搜索方法（缺乏语义引导）与近期大语言模型（LLM）方法（常常遭受浅层模式匹配与因果不透明）之间的二分。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce ECCO, a framework that bridges interpretable reasoning with combinatorial search.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入 ECCO，一个桥接可解释推理与组合搜索的框架。

sentences.en: We first propose a reverse engineering methodology to construct a Chain-of-Thought dataset, explicitly mapping static code features to verifiable performance evidence.
sentences.zh: 我们首先提出一种逆向工程方法构建思维链数据集，显式将静态代码特征映射到可验证的性能证据。

sentences.en: This enables the model to learn the causal logic governing optimization decisions rather than merely imitating sequences.
sentences.zh: 这使得模型能够学习支配优化决策的因果逻辑，而非仅仅模仿序列。

sentences.en: Leveraging this interpretable prior, we design a collaborative inference mechanism where the LLM functions as a strategist, defining optimization intents that dynamically guide the mutation operations of a genetic algorithm.
sentences.zh: 利用这一可解释先验，我们设计一种协作推断机制，其中 LLM 充当策略师，定义动态引导遗传算法变异操作的优化意图。

sentences.en: Experimental results on seven datasets demonstrate that ECCO outperforms the LLVM opt -O3 baseline, achieving an average 24.44% reduction in cycles.
sentences.zh: 在七个数据集上的实验结果表明，ECCO 超越 LLVM opt -O3 基线，实现平均 24.44% 的循环数减少。

title_en: ECG-R1: Protocol-Guided and Modality-Agnostic MLLM for Reliable ECG Interpretation
title_zh: ECG-R1：协议引导且模态无关的多模态大语言模型，实现可靠心电图解读

sentences.en: Electrocardiography (ECG) serves as an indispensable diagnostic tool in clinical practice, yet existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain unreliable for ECG interpretation, often producing plausible but clinically incorrect analyses.
sentences.zh: 心电图（ECG）在临床实践中是不可或缺的诊断工具，然而现有的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在 ECG 解释上仍不可靠，常常产生貌似合理但临床不正确的分析。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose ECG-R1, the first reasoning ECG MLLM designed for reliable ECG interpretation via three innovations.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出 ECG-R1，首个通过三项创新设计用于可靠 ECG 解释的推理 ECG MLLM。

sentences.en: First, we construct the interpretation corpus using \textit{Protocol-Guided Instruction Data Generation}, grounding interpretation in measurable ECG features and monograph-defined quantitative thresholds and diagnostic logic.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们使用*协议引导的指令数据生成*构建解释语料库，将解释立足于可测量的 ECG 特征与专著定义的定量阈值及诊断逻辑。

sentences.en: Second, we present a modality-decoupled architecture with \textit{Interleaved Modality Dropout} to improve robustness and cross-modal consistency when either the ECG signal or ECG image is missing.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们提出一个带*交错模态 Dropout* 的模态解耦架构，以改善当 ECG 信号或 ECG 图像缺失时的稳健性与跨模态一致性。

sentences.en: Third, we present \textit{Reinforcement Learning with ECG Diagnostic Evidence Rewards} to strengthen evidence-grounded ECG interpretation.
sentences.zh: 第三，我们提出*带 ECG 诊断证据奖励的强化学习*，以强化证据立足的 ECG 解释。

sentences.en: Additionally, we systematically evaluate the ECG interpretation capabilities of proprietary, open-source, and medical MLLMs, and provide the first quantitative evidence that severe hallucinations are widespread, suggesting that the public should not directly trust these outputs without independent verification.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们系统评估专有、开源与医学 MLLM 的 ECG 解释能力，并提供首个定量证据表明严重幻觉广泛存在，提示公众不应在未独立验证的情况下直接信任这些输出。

sentences.en: Code is available at \href{https://github.com/PKUDigitalHealth/ECG-R1}{here}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/PKUDigitalHealth/ECG-R1 获取。

title_en: ECHO: Elastic Speculative Decoding with Sparse Gating for High-Concurrency Scenarios
title_zh: ECHO：用于高并发场景的稀疏门控弹性推测解码

sentences.en: Speculative Decodin promises to accelerate Large Language Model inference, yet its efficacy often degrades in production-grade scenarios.
sentences.zh: 投机解码有望加速大语言模型推断，然而其有效性在生产级场景中常常退化。

sentences.en: Existing evaluations typically overlook the compute-bound nature of high-concurrency regimes, where verification compute becomes the dominant bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 现有的评估通常忽视高并发区间的计算受限性质，其中验证计算成为主导瓶颈。

sentences.en: Consequently, prior methods face a dilemma: static trees incur massive verification waste, while dynamic trees suffer from cumulative misjudgments and kernel incompatibility.
sentences.zh: 因此，先前方法面临困境：静态树招致大量验证浪费，而动态树遭受累积误判与内核不兼容。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce ECHO, a high concurrency-oriented framework integrated into SGLang that reformulates speculative execution as a budgeted scheduling problem.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们引入 ECHO，一个面向高并发、整合进 SGLang 的框架，它将投机执行重新表述为预算化调度问题。

sentences.en: Crucially, ECHO employs sparse confidence gating to manage the batch as a unified super-tree, elastically pivoting budget between depth and width to co-optimize the trade-off between reducing global verification steps and maximizing per-step efficiency.
sentences.zh: 关键的是，ECHO 采用稀疏置信门控将批次管理为统一超树，在深度与宽度之间弹性枢转预算，以共同优化减少全局验证步骤与最大化每步效率之间的权衡。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations across diverse model scales—particularly the industrial-grade Qwen3-235B—demonstrate that ECHO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both low-load and high-load scenarios, achieving up to 5.35$\times$ walltime speedup and delivering over 20\% relative speedup gain against the strongest baselines.
sentences.zh: 跨多样模型规模（尤其是工业级 Qwen3-235B）的大量评估表明，ECHO 在低负载与高负载场景中都一致超越最先进基线，实现至多 5.35\times 的墙钟加速，并相对最强基线提供超过 20% 的相对加速增益。

title_en: ECHO: Entropy-Confidence Hybrid Optimization for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: ECHO：用于测试时强化学习的熵–置信度混合优化

sentences.en: Test-time reinforcement learning generates multiple candidate answers via repeated rollouts and performs online updates using pseudo-labels constructed by majority voting.
sentences.zh: 测试时强化学习通过重复 rollout 生成多个候选答案，并使用多数投票构造的伪标签执行在线更新。

sentences.en: To reduce overhead and improve exploration, prior work introduces tree-structured rollouts, which share reasoning prefixes and branch at key nodes to improve sampling efficiency.
sentences.zh: 为降低开销与改善探索，先前工作引入树结构 rollout，它共享推理前缀并在关键节点分支以提高采样效率。

sentences.en: However, this paradigm still faces two challenges: (1) high-entropy branching can trigger rollout collapse, where the branching budget concentrates on a few trajectories with consecutive high-entropy segments, rapidly reducing the number of effective branches; (2) early pseudo-labels are noisy and biased, which can induce self-reinforcing overfitting, causing the policy to sharpen prematurely and suppress exploration.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一范式仍面临两个挑战：（1）高熵分支可能触发 rollout 坍缩，其中分支预算集中在少数几个具有连续高熵片段的轨迹上，迅速减少有效分支数量；（2）早期伪标签含噪且有偏，可能诱导自我强化的过拟合，导致策略过早锐化并抑制探索。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose Entropy–Confidence Hybrid Group Relative Policy Optimization (ECHO).
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出熵-置信度混合组相对策略优化（ECHO）。

sentences.en: During rollout, ECHO jointly leverages local entropy and group-level confidence to adaptively control branch width, and further introduces online confidence-based pruning to terminate persistently low-confidence branches, avoiding high-entropy traps and mitigating collapse.
sentences.zh: 在 rollout 期间，ECHO 联合利用局部熵与组级置信度自适应控制分支宽度，并进一步引入在线基于置信度的剪枝以终止持续低置信度分支，避免高熵陷阱并缓解坍缩。

sentences.en: During policy updates, ECHO employs confidence-adaptive clipping and an entropy–confidence hybrid advantage shaping approach to enhance training robustness and mitigate early-stage bias.
sentences.zh: 在策略更新期间，ECHO 采用置信度自适应裁剪与熵-置信度混合优势塑形方法，增强训练稳健性并缓解早期偏差。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that ECHO achieves consistent gains on multiple mathematical and visual reasoning benchmarks, and generalizes more effectively under a limited rollout budget.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，ECHO 在多个数学与视觉推理基准上实现一致的增益，并在有限 rollout 预算下更有效地泛化。

title_en: EchoAttention: Exploiting Token-Pair Redundancy and Frame-Block Similarity for Efficient Video Generation
title_zh: EchoAttention：利用词元对冗余与帧块相似性实现高效视频生成

sentences.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) are increasingly adopted for long-video generation, yet inference is dominated by the quadratic cost of 3D full attention.
sentences.zh: 扩散 Transformer（DiT）正日益被采用于长视频生成，然而推断被 3D 全注意力的二次成本主导。

sentences.en: Sparse attention mitigates this bottleneck by exploiting *token-pair redundancy* and pruning query-key interactions.
sentences.zh: 稀疏注意力通过利用*词元对冗余*并剪除查询-键交互来缓解这一瓶颈。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, its effectiveness on video generation is often constrained by non-sparse attention heads, making it hard to strike a good balance between inference speed and generation quality.
sentences.zh: 然而，它在视频生成上的有效性常常受到非稀疏注意力头的限制，使其难以在推断速度与生成质量之间取得良好平衡。

sentences.en: To address this, we identify another pervasive but overlooked redundancy specific to video DiTs: *frame-block similarity*, where frame-blocks in attention weights exhibit highly similar distributions and can be well approximated by lightweight linear calibration.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们识别出视频 DiT 特有的另一种普遍但被忽视的冗余：*帧块相似性*，其中注意力权重中的帧块表现出高度相似的分布，可以被轻量级线性校准良好逼近。

sentences.en: Motivated by this observation, we propose **EchoAttention**, which jointly leverages *token-pair redundancy* (*Sparse* operator) and *frame-block similarity* (*Echo* operator), together with a fine-grained routing policy learned via three-stage distillation.
sentences.zh: 受这一观察激励，我们提出 **EchoAttention**，它联合利用*词元对冗余*（*Sparse* 算子）与*帧块相似性*（*Echo* 算子），配以通过三阶段蒸馏学到的细粒度路由策略。

sentences.en: This design enables efficient handling of both sparse and non-sparse heads, overcoming the inherent ceiling of purely sparse attention and yielding a better speed-quality trade-off.
sentences.zh: 这一设计支持高效处理稀疏与非稀疏头，克服纯稀疏注意力的固有天花板，并产生更好的速度-质量权衡。

sentences.en: Across public video DiTs, EchoAttention consistently improves the speed-quality frontier over SOTA sparse-attention baselines, reducing end-to-end latency up to 2.42$\times$ with minimal quality loss.
sentences.zh: 跨公共视频 DiT，EchoAttention 一致改善 SOTA 稀疏注意力基线的速度-质量前沿，以极小的质量损失将端到端延迟减少至多 2.42\times。

title_en: Echoes within the Reasoning:  Stealthy and Effective Watermarking via Chain of Thought
title_zh: 推理中的回声：通过思维链实现隐蔽且有效的水印

sentences.en: Large Language Models with Chain-of-Thought reasoning capabilities represent valuable intellectual property, yet existing black-box watermarking methods often trade robustness for reasoning fidelity by perturbing final answers or relying on fragile trigger patterns.
sentences.zh: 带思维链推理能力的大语言模型代表宝贵的知识产权，然而现有的黑盒水印方法常常通过扰动最终答案或依赖脆弱的触发模式，用稳健性换取推理保真度。

sentences.en: We propose BiCoT, a watermarking framework that embeds ownership signals into the internal geometry of reasoning traces by aligning high-saliency structural anchors with a private signature subspace while regularizing ordinary control tokens to preserve semantic capacity.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 BiCoT，一个通过将高显著性结构锚点与私有签名子空间对齐、同时正则化普通控制词元以保留语义容量，将所有权信号嵌入推理轨迹内部几何的水印框架。

sentences.en: This design couples the watermark with reasoning-relevant representations, making removal difficult without disrupting the features that support coherent reasoning.
sentences.zh: 这一设计将水印与推理相关表示耦合，使在不破坏支持连贯推理的特征的情况下移除水印变得困难。

sentences.en: To enable verification under model theft and representation drift, we introduce Robust Subspace Registration(RSR), a Top-$k$ logprob-based black-box verifier that uses sentinel tokens to calibrate systematic shifts in the output distribution.
sentences.zh: 为支持模型窃取与表示漂移下的验证，我们引入稳健子空间注册（RSR），一个基于 Top-k logprob 的黑盒验证器，它使用哨兵词元校准输出分布中的系统性偏移。

sentences.en: Experiments show that BiCoT preserves reasoning fidelity across diverse complex reasoning tasks while achieving robust detection under fine-tuning, quantization, model-level perturbations, and adaptive output-level attacks across in-domain and out-of-distribution settings.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，BiCoT 在多样复杂推理任务上保持推理保真度，同时实现在微调、量化、模型级扰动与自适应输出级攻击下的稳健检测，覆盖分布内与分布外情境。

title_en: EchoingPixels: Aliasing-Resistant Joint Token Reduction for Audio-Visual LLMs
title_zh: EchoingPixels：视听大语言模型的抗混叠联合词元缩减

sentences.en: Audio-Visual Large Language Models (AV-LLMs) face prohibitive computational costs of processing massive, redundant audio-visual tokens.
sentences.zh: 音视频大语言模型（AV-LLM）面临处理海量、冗余音视频词元的过高计算成本。

sentences.en: Existing unimodal compression techniques fail to capture the heterogeneous and mutually influential information density of joint audio-visual signals.
sentences.zh: 现有的单模态压缩技术无法捕获联合音视频信号的异构且相互影响的信息密度。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we identify a fundamental and overlooked theoretical bottleneck in sparse token reduction: positional aliasing.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们识别出稀疏词元缩减中一个根本且被忽视的理论瓶颈：位置混叠。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that aggressive sparse sampling on standard position-encoded sequences violates the Nyquist limit relative to the effective token interval, causing phase-wrapping collisions that corrupt temporal monotonicity.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对标准位置编码序列进行激进的稀疏采样违反了相对于有效词元间隔的 Nyquist 极限，导致相位折绕碰撞，破坏时间单调性。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce EchoingPixels, a framework for aliasing-resistant joint token reduction.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们引入 EchoingPixels，一个抗混叠联合词元缩减框架。

sentences.en: Our Cross-Modal Semantic Sieve performs extractive selection on the synergistic audio-visual stream, dynamically allocating budgets based on joint-modality saliency rather than fixed per-modality ratios.
sentences.zh: 我们的跨模态语义筛对协同音视频流执行抽取式选择，基于联合模态显著性动态分配预算，而非固定的逐模态比例。

sentences.en: To resolve positional aliasing, we derive Sync-RoPE, a spectral low-pass filter for Rotary Positional Embeddings that adapts encoding bandwidth to the sparse sampling rate, preserving monotonic temporal relationships in the reduced stream.
sentences.zh: 为解决位置混叠，我们推导 Sync-RoPE，一个用于旋转位置嵌入的谱低通滤波器，它使编码带宽自适应稀疏采样率，在缩减流中保留单调时间关系。

sentences.en: Experiments show that EchoingPixels achieves performance comparable to full models using only 5-20% of original tokens, validating theoretically grounded sparse learning as a robust solution for efficient AV-LLMs.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，EchoingPixels 仅用原始词元的 5-20% 就实现与完整模型相当的 性能和，验证了理论立足的稀疏学习作为高效 AV-LLM 的稳健解决方案。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/CharlesGong12/EchoingPixels.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/CharlesGong12/EchoingPixels 获取。
